title: Young people: share your views on youth protests around the world
text:
High school students demonstrating in Bordeaux, 8 October 2026. Photograph: Ugo Amez/SIPA/Shutterstock
Young people: share your views on youth protests around the world
Young people in France, India and Albania and other parts of the world are protesting and we want to hear from them about the reasons why they’re taking to the streets
Young people in different parts of the world are protesting and we want to hear from them about the reasons they’re taking to the streets and on social media.
We’d like to hear from young people in countries where youth-led protests have taken place. What is your perspective on them? Have you taken part? What needs to change?
Share your experience
Please share your response in the form below or by messaging us.
Please share your story if you are 18 or over, anonymously if you wish. For more information please see our terms of service and privacy policy.
Tell us here
Message us
Your responses, which can be anonymous, are secure as the form is encrypted and only the Guardian has access to your contributions. We will only use the data you provide us for the purpose of the feature and we will delete any personal data when we no longer require it for this purpose. For alternative ways to get in touch securely please see our tips guide.
